articles.title_en: Power goes dark across a Russian resort city under drone warning, a week after a beach strike killed seven
articles.lead_en: Residents of Gelendzhik began reporting citywide power outages on the afternoon of August 10, the news outlet 93.ru reported. A warning of possible Ukrainian drone attacks had been in effect in the city since early morning; sirens were sounding periodically, and the beaches were closed.

articles.title_en: 12 killed in Ukrainian drone strike on Russia’s Nizhnekamsk
articles.lead_en: A Ukrainian drone attack on Nizhnekamsk killed 12 people and injured 39, the press service of the head of the Republic of Tatarstan reported on August 10.
